spans.s: † रुश् रुश्, i. 6, Par. To hurt.

1. रुष् रुष् (akin to रुक्ष् in रुक्ष), † i. 1 and 4, Par. † To hurt.
 --† i. 4 and i. 10, Par. To be angry.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रुष्ट (Pañc. 223, 9; Śṛṅgārat. 7), रुषित (

), and रोषित, Enraged.
 --Caus. To irritate, Pañc. 163, 4. रोषित, Irritated, Daśak. in

.
 --Cf. probably λύσσα, perhaps ἀλυσταίνω, ἀλυκταίνω, ἀλαλύκτημαι; Goth. in-rauhtjan.

2. रुष् रुष् (and रुषा रुष् + आ), f. Wrath, anger, Pañc. iv. d. 61; Vikr. d. 80.
 --Comp.

. To tremble.
 2. To burst.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. रूषित.
 1. Adorned,

. Made rough or rugged.
 4. Pounded, reduced to dust.

रुशन्त्, adj.
 I. Probably originally a ptcple. pres. of रुच्, f. शती, Red,

= Rigv. i. 48, 13.
 II. Probably a ptcple. pres. of रुष्, Cursing, imprecative.
